summary: NanoViricides, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose an At Market Issuance Sales Agreement with D. Boral Capital LLC, allowing the company to sell shares of its common stock in an at-the-market offering under Rule 415(a)(4). The shares are offered under an existing shelf registration statement on Form S-3. The sales agent receives a 2% commission. No specific price, premium, or deal terms are stated. This is a routine capital-raising arrangement, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
